purpose: Test tick-rooted short-window order-flow momentum as an opportunity source whose timescale matches the frozen 30-second lifecycle.

source_basis.source: MetaQuotes — Market Microstructure in MQL5 Part 6: Order Flow
source_basis.logic: OrderFlowImbalance is signed directional flow and OrderFlowMomentum is short-window minus long-window flow; positive momentum means directional pressure is building.

source_basis.source: MetaQuotes — Tick Buffer VWAP and Short-Window Imbalance Engine
source_basis.logic: When DOM is unavailable, tick direction can proxy buy/sell pressure; flow=(up-dn)/(up+dn) over a rolling seconds window.
Tick-rule imbalance is a reconstructible proxy for directional signal validation; tick imbalance/event sampling is appropriate for order-flow studies.

source_basis.source: TradingView open source — Order Imbalance / Volume Regime
source_basis.logic: Confirmed historical up/down tick-rule imbalance normalized to [-1,1] is used as a descriptive pressure proxy.

adaptation: Because DELTA owns true tick chronology and the economic lifecycle is 30 seconds, the public short-minus-long flow grammar is evaluated on 1-second aggregates with frozen 10s/30s windows rather than M1 bars. This is a timescale adaptation, not a threshold optimization.

configs.C01_FLOW_MOMENTUM_ZERO_CROSS: Signal long when 10s tick-flow minus 30s tick-flow crosses from <=0 to >0 while 10s flow is >0; inverse short.
configs.C02_FLOW_IMBALANCE_ZERO_CROSS: Signal when 10s normalized tick-flow itself crosses zero; direction follows new sign.
configs.C03_FLOW_MOMENTUM_PRICE_AGREE: As C01, and 10s completed-second price displacement has the same sign as the signal.
configs.C04_FLOW_MOMENTUM_PERSIST2: C01 zero-cross must remain same-sign on the next completed second before signal.
